title: JurisFlow AI: Legal Intelligence
summary: A multi-agent legal platform for Indian law, supporting legal research, drafting, document analysis and client-related workflows.
overview: A legal practice platform for Indian law firms with four AI agents behind a shared secure gateway. The stack is a FastAPI and PostgreSQL back end with a Next.js dashboard for lawyer, client and firm-owner roles.
capabilities: Research agent: searches the web and Indian Kanoon, reads judgments and returns precedents with analysis.
Draft agent: turns a prompt into a semi-finished court-style document exported as `.docx`.
Summarizer agent: extracts text from PDFs, documents or images and flags key clauses, dates and risks.
Client-update agent: drafts a plain-English case update for a lawyer to review and send.
Safeguards on every request: login and role checks, rate limiting and a legal-only guard, with a Gemini fallback model.
useCases: Speeding up first-pass case research and drafting in a law practice.
A reference architecture for role-based, multi-agent AI applications.

title: Multimodal Data Analyst Agent
summary: An agentic data analysis backend that processes multiple file formats, generates Python analysis code and produces insights and visualizations using isolated Docker execution.
overview: Users upload data files with a natural-language question. The service asks Gemini to write Python analysis code and runs that code inside a Docker container, returning results and charts.
capabilities: Accepts CSV, JSON, HTML, ZIP, Excel, text and other file types in one request.
Generates analysis code from the question for statistical, network, time-series and machine-learning tasks.
Executes generated code in an isolated container with resource limits and code validation.
Returns structured results with visualizations as base64 images.
Automatic OpenAPI documentation and request logging.
useCases: Ad-hoc analysis of uploaded datasets without writing code.
A pattern for sandboxed execution of LLM-generated code.

title: Virtual Teaching Assistant
summary: A retrieval-augmented teaching assistant for IIT Madras's Tools in Data Science course, using course and discussion content to answer student questions.
overview: A virtual TA that collects course material and forum discussions, indexes them in a FAISS vector store and serves question answering with references through a FastAPI API.
capabilities: Scrapers for the course website and the IITM Discourse forum.
A preprocessing pipeline that cleans the content and builds the vector index.
A `/query` endpoint that returns an answer with relevant references.
A Promptfoo configuration for evaluating the assistant's answers.
Deployment configuration for Render.
useCases: Answering recurring student questions from course and forum content.
A template for course-specific RAG assistants.

title: NepalAI Movie Discovery
summary: A Nepali movie discovery application featuring natural-language search and personalized movie recommendations.
overview: A web application for exploring Nepali cinema. A React front end talks to a Django REST back end that uses the Gemini API for conversational search. The README marks the project as in development.
capabilities: AI-powered search that understands conversational queries.
Personalised recommendations based on user preferences.
A movie database with plot summaries, ratings and genre categories.
Genre browsing and a responsive interface.
JWT-based user authentication and profiles.
useCases: Helping viewers find Nepali films by describing what they want.
A reference for combining an LLM with a recommender in a Django and React stack.

title: Spatial Studio: Browser Hand Tracking
summary: Browser-local hand tracking with QR-paired phone controls, spatial ink, maths demonstrations and gesture-based pottery.
overview: Camera frames are processed in the browser on the device that owns the camera. A separate Cloudflare Worker with one Durable Object per pairing relays phone motion, touch and hand landmarks over WebSockets.
capabilities: Hand tracking on the laptop with MediaPipe on CPU/WASM, and on the phone with GPU and CPU fallback.
QR-code pairing of a phone as a controller; codes are single-use and expire after ten minutes.
Creative modes: spatial drawing, maths demonstrations and gesture-based pottery.
A tracking lab for two-camera fingertip tracking with stereo calibration scripts.
A timing panel that reports model startup, inference and relay round trip.
useCases: Exploring camera-based, touch-free interaction in the browser.
A reference for privacy-preserving, on-device vision with a lightweight relay.
note: The README describes the tracking lab as a measurement experiment, not a validated sculpting tool.

title: Content DNA Analyzer
summary: Measures how a video is built and produces timestamped, evidence-backed suggestions for improving retention and reach.
overview: Give it a YouTube URL or a video file and it measures pacing, hook, speech, sound, visual formats and narrative structure, then builds a creative fingerprint and a critique checked against the measured data.
capabilities: A scorecard over 16 researched drivers of retention and reach, each marked as sourced, heuristic or genre-range based.
Pain points pinned to the timeline and a frame-by-frame strip with one keyframe per shot.
Optional fixes written by an LLM that cite the measured evidence.
Static demos that need no server, plus a command-line tool and a documented HTTP API.
useCases: Reviewing a video's structure before publishing.
Comparing a video against genre norms.
note: The README describes the checks as guidance to test, not predicted performance.

title: Multi-Agent Business Analytics
summary: A multi-agent backend enabling natural-language analytics across Google Analytics 4 and SEO data.
overview: An orchestrator routes a plain-English question to an analytics agent (Google Analytics 4) or an SEO agent (data in Google Sheets) and formats the answer. The repository includes a technical document.
capabilities: Natural-language queries over GA4 properties through a `/query` endpoint.
Separate analytics and SEO agents with an orchestrator and response formatter.
LLM access through an OpenAI-compatible client with LiteLLM.
Health check, interactive API docs and a Dockerfile.
useCases: Letting marketers ask questions of their analytics without building reports.
A template for agent orchestration over business data sources.

title: Automatic Brand Placement Audit
summary: A video-analysis pipeline measuring sponsor exposure in football broadcasts using OCR, frame processing and multilingual text matching.
overview: Measures which sponsor boards appear in football broadcast video, for how long, and how much of that falls around the goals. The OCR stage runs on macOS with Apple Vision.
capabilities: Extracts one frame per second with FFmpeg and reads each frame with Apple Vision, including tiled passes and a Chinese-language pass.
Matches recognised text to a brand lexicon.
Hand-labelled evidence, versioned benchmark runs and a cost model with sources are kept in the repository.
A data-story site presents the method and findings.
useCases: Auditing sponsor visibility in broadcast footage.
A reference for costed, benchmarked video-OCR pipelines.
note: The README reports about 14 minutes and roughly $0.26-$0.31 of Mac host time per hour of 1080p video on its test machine. Match footage and raw OCR output are not in the repository.

title: Intelli-Credit AI
summary: A credit-assessment workflow integrating financial document extraction, external research, risk analysis and credit appraisal memorandum generation.
overview: A FastAPI service that automates a loan appraisal pipeline in three stages: parse financial documents, gather external intelligence, then score the applicant and produce a Credit Appraisal Memo.
capabilities: Document ingestion for PDF and CSV, with an LLM extracting structured financial data.
External research via web search and scraping, followed by LLM risk analysis.
Five Cs credit scoring and decision logic.
Credit Appraisal Memo generation as Word and PDF downloads.
useCases: Speeding up first-pass credit appraisal.
A reference pipeline for document-to-decision workflows.

title: Telemarketing Prediction Service
summary: A machine-learning application for predicting whether customers are likely to subscribe to a term deposit following a telemarketing campaign.
overview: A machine-learning practice project: models trained on historical campaign data are served through a Flask web form where customer details are entered to get a prediction.
capabilities: Data preprocessing and a saved preprocessing pipeline.
Experiments with logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost.
Evaluation with accuracy, precision, recall and F1.
A Flask web application for interactive predictions.
useCases: Prioritising customers for outreach in a campaign.
A small end-to-end example of training and serving a tabular classifier.
